pkgmetadata.longdescription: LDC is a D compiler based on the LLVM infrastructure. This package follows Arch extra/ldc's cmake/ninja build and uses the matching upstream binary LDC release only as the bootstrap compiler. The runtime and Phobos (Arch's liblphobos) are produced by the same cmake build using the just-built ldc2, so they are installed here rather than as a separate package. LLVM 15–21 are supported.
